observations.summary: Hardness is dissolved calcium and magnesium; scale in water heaters and pipes; soap scum; very hard above 180 mg/L as calcium carbonate.
Community water systems must deliver an annual Consumer Confidence Report by July 1 with water source, contaminants found and health standard violations.
Private well owners are responsible for delivering safe drinking water; federal government and most states do not regulate private well water quality.

observations.summary: Brine harms tank bacteria, reduces capacity, clogs leach field, adds hydraulic load causing surfacing effluent; ground discharge prohibited (County Code 7.38 and 7.79); sewer-connected homes discharge to sewer; preference order: no softener, exchange tank, separate drywell or subsurface system; discharge to septic highly discouraged.
SCCC 7.38.150(A)(5): discharge from water softeners, drinking water filters, swimming pool filter backwash and other non-domestic wastewater shall not be discharged to the septic system.
observations.inference_limit: County ordinance; the handout guidance on exchange tanks and drywells is separate.
